messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service-discovery.srv.lookup failures spike in us-west-2a affecting internal healthchecks. Pager: oncall-rotation, severity: P1. https://pd.example/INC12345
alex: seeing lots of 503s from control-plane -> worker-proxy. initial spike ~2172468005. any recent deploys?
maria: no deploys in that window from networking or platform. I'm checking CoreDNS and Consul.
kevin: noticed high TCP conn churn on coredns nodes in us-west-2a, some peers in consul reporting "conn reset by peer" to the leader. pulling logs.
anna: customer-facing: a handful of internal customer jobs are failing host discovery; CX already pinged. Tagging james to assess hit list. james: on it, collecting tenant IDs and impact windows.
oncall-rotation: alex, you're assigned incident commander. maria, take DNS/SD lead. kevin, infra support. anna, customer comms.
alex: ack. immediate steps: 1) validate SRV lookups via dig from control-plane in affected AZ 2) check coredns pods + system limits 3) check consul leader health and raft.
maria: running dig: 
```
kubectl exec -n infra control-plane-1 -- dig +short SRV _svc._tcp.svc.cluster.local @10.100.2.5
```
response: intermittent timeouts, sometimes partial results.
kevin: consul members show frequent flapping in us-west-2a: `consul operator raft list-peers` shows follower timeouts and leader re-election attempts. syslog has TCP RSTs between instances.
anna: james, update on customers: 4 internal jobs failed in the last 10m with service lookup errors; most are non-prod but 1 critical analytics job for PartnerX is impacted. they reported degraded ingestion.
james: contacting PartnerX SRE to notify; providing mitigation ETA.
alex: mitigation plan: (A) move control-plane read traffic to us-west-2b standby (B) scale up coredns replica set in us-west-2a to reduce overload (C) temporarily bump consul gossip/bandwidth timeouts and restrict cross-AZ peering for raft to force local quorum. any objections?
maria: (B) and (A) good. for (C) prefer to limit raft to same AZ by setting `raft_protocol` change? that's risky. alternative: increase tcp_keepalive and consul dial-timeout to reduce churn.
kevin: I can create a routing rule to prefer us-west-2b for lookups and failover; will apply a conservative route map. also increasing coredns pod requests/limits to avoid OOMs.
alex: kevin - do it. maria - scale coredns to 5 replicas in us-west-2a and restart pods gracefully. use rolling restart.
maria: doing: `kubectl scale deploy coredns -n kube-system --replicas=5` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/coredns -n kube-system`
(maria): noting sticky connmap entries; will also clear iptables conntrack on nodes if pods still show failures.
kevin: route change pushed at 2172468320: control-plane lookups now prefer us-west-2b. monitoring for errors to drop.
anna: customer comms: posted to PartnerX slack that we're actively mitigating and expect partial recovery in ~10-20m.
james: PartnerX confirmed they're seeing reduced errors after ~6m. still some backpressure in ingestion.
maria: coredns replicas up and stabilizing, CPU spike subsiding. Consul still showing a follower lagging; forcing a restart of the lagging consul agent after draining. command: `systemctl restart consul` on node ip-10-0-23-45
kevin: restarted node consul agent at 2172468452, node rejoined, raft leader stable now.
alex: good. validate end-to-end: run SRV lookups and internal healthchecks.
maria: running internal sweeps: most SRV lookups now succeed from control-plane in us-west-2a and us-west-2b. a few pods still had stale cache entries; flushed cache by deleting coredns pods earlier.
anna: PartnerX confirms ingestion returning to normal. marking customer impact as partial for ~18m window.
james: logging timeline and impact list; will follow up with RCA request.
alex: post-incident actions: - RCA: investigate network flaps between AZ peering and why consul lost quorum - add automated failover to prefer cross-AZ reads after X% error - add alert that combines SRV lookup error rate + consul raft re-elections - run chaos test for consul in staging.
oncall-rotation: transitioning to oncall-rotation for follow-up; alex handing off as IC to kevin; kevin you'll be the bridge for any on-call queries for next 2h.
kevin: ack handoff. I'll monitor raft and coredns metrics and coordinate RCA write-up.
alex: thanks team. closing the active pager. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 status changed to Resolved by alex at 2172468833
